name: Alap
note: Carries a vowel at the start of a word. At the end of a word it is written but not said.

name: Beth
note: A plain b. With a soft dot below it becomes w.

name: Gamal
note: A hard g. A soft dot gives gh; a tilde below gives j.

name: Dalath
note: The dot sits below. Resh is the same shape with the dot above.

name: He
note: A light h. It is often barely heard in the middle of a word, as in sahra.

name: Waw
note: The sound w. With a dot above it carries o; with a dot below it carries u.

name: Zain
note: A short downward stroke. It never joins to the letter after it.

name: Kheth
note: The kh of khamsha and akhnan.

name: Teth
note: The deep t of tura and mitra. Taw is the lighter t.

name: Yodh
note: The sound y. With a dot below it carries the long i of ilana.

name: Kap
note: A plain k. A soft dot gives kh; a tilde below gives ch.

name: Lamadh
note: The tall slanted stroke. Alap after it often leans in to meet it.

name: Mim
note: The sound m, as in malka and yimma.

name: Nun
note: A small hook inside a word, a long tail at the end of one.

name: Simkath
note: The everyday s, as in sahra.

name: E
note: An old throat sound. In everyday speech it is mostly not said, as in arba and zora.

name: Pe
note: A plain p. With a small curved mark below it becomes f.

name: Sadhe
note: The deep s. Simkath is the lighter s.

name: Qop
note: The q made at the back of the mouth, as in aqla.

name: Resh
note: The dot sits above. Dalath is the same shape with the dot below.

name: Shin
note: The sh of shlama and shimsha. A tilde below gives zh.

name: Taw
note: The light t. With a soft dot it becomes th.
